about: Follows of the height grid by tools/ground_follow.py, in order: what moved with the ground, by id. The rocks and city objects keep their own moves as kyt_ground_moved_<id> and kyt_ground_raised_<id>; the roosts' and birds' are here. Undo: --undo <id>.
